Only one original target exists; no retarget. At each future regular caster turn an Action may maintain one further pulse against that same still-existing original creature target, with perception/range60/line of effect rechecked. At most one pulse per original regular caster-turn cycle; extra turns/Actions grant none. If no maintenance Action is completed during an available future regular turn, the channel ends at that turn's END; a miss still counts as maintenance. Outside initiative an otherwise capable caster spends the equivalent whole Action at each successive six-second cycle; missed maintenance ends it. This completion does not import Leeching Plague's hostile-living-nonconstruct donor filter, provide healing to a dead caster, or grant repair, resurrection, resource farming or an exception to another source's exclusion flags.

previousSharedProposalUnchanged.geometry: Named targets and chosen centers require actual perception and caster line of effect. previousSharedProposalUnchanged.clocks: A proposed minute is60 elapsed seconds, hour3600 and day86400. Expiry wins at its exact deadline. Resistance halves the matching component with normal rounding. actualDamageDealt=tempHP absorbed+actual ordinary HP lost, excluding overkill, state-assignment loss and double-counted parent/child transfer packets. A BA selects exactly one body and one ordinary Move plus its single profiled Action or ordinary permitted basic Action, executed only in the owner's existing attached phase after the whole owner turn. Every other capable body has only defensive Move and Dodge in that phase. No independent initiative, Reaction, BA, multiattack, spellcasting, Help engine, tool proficiency, resource pool or summon power exists. Committed orders retain reviewed validity rules. Damage/control consumes the shared offensive allowance; support still needs its paid command. Original source owner supplies the current spell attack and PB-based saves; changing controller grants no second cap or new source stats. Each independent application keeps its actual duration and original ownership. Legal ordinary companion healing cannot reconstruct a destroyed body or refill absent resources.

Animate only actual eligible non-summoned, non-copied, non-illusory, not-previously-raised remains; fragments do not become extra bodies. These spells do not grant Wizard Corpse Harvest, Auto-Raise, Infernal Pact or Mage assets. NEW spent animated remains retain their physical identity and actual inventory, with consumed status: no second raising/harvest fuel and no refreshed recipe donor qualities. An actual resurrection source must meet its reviewed reconstruction requirements for a consumed body; this packet grants none. Created summons leave no corpse/loot. Source-qualified maximum-HP modifiers require genuine access and actual spell provenance; a Wizard spell creation can qualify for its actual Conjuration modifier, never a generic borrowed Wizard level. previousSharedProposalUnchanged.zombieProfile: NEW shared Flood/Danse zombie animation profile: actual Small or Medium eligible body, type Undead; baseAC10, baseHP20, walk20feet only with its original functional walking supports; STR12, DEX6, CON14, INT3, WIS6, CHA3. No resistances, immunities, Undead Fortitude, regeneration, death saves, loot reward, donor substrate or other zombie powers are imported. completeSharedRules.P20-CASTING-01: Reuse actual class-access/repertoire, paid costs, component, concentration and Dissonance/Refrain procedures from the exact registry. None of these drafts grants a new class row, rank, upcast or resource maximum. A continuous field, stored rider or command does not itself cast again. Actual target/caster predicates are rechecked at the source-defined checkpoint, without refund or diagnostic disclosure from hidden failure.
completeSharedRules.P20-DIGITAL-GEOMETRY-01: NEW bounded clarification for these 20 proposals: measure the actual occupied body against the continuous authored volume/surface, with actual cover/line of effect. Five-foot lengths remain real lengths, not a rounding of positions onto tabletop squares. Source-authored five-foot destructible/fuel partitions remain fixed object identities; changing path sampling, zoom or visual mesh subdivision cannot create more targets, HP or exposure. Evaluate a genuine entry at the first boundary crossing/contact, resolve it once before continuing the same trajectory, and preserve actual remaining movement. Teleport crosses no intermediate path; an arrival can trigger only a source explicitly authorizing arrival. Snapshot simultaneous recipients once before their consequences; destroyed cover creates no second wave.
completeSharedRules.P20-CLOCKS-01: NEW explicit cohort bindings: absolute field deadlines are resolution+60 seconds where the procedure states one minute; expiry wins at equality. Source-owned pulses at resolution and +6 through +54 do not require a caster turn or grant a creature turn. A finite target/source marker schedule records its original regular markers at creation under accepted time ordering; reorder, extra turns and departure preserve the original virtual schedule, six seconds apart. Explicit future-turn endpoints exclude an in-progress turn/phase; an ending save expressly including current END keeps that exception. At START, apply accepted expiry/recovery/death-save ordering before periodic damage. At END, due damage/eligible ending saves precede that source endpoint cleanup, except a card explicitly expires before its redundant last save. Suppression consumes a due scheduled opportunity with no damage or catch-up. Ended creature identities have no recipient; administrative deadline bookkeeping never resurrects one.
completeSharedRules.P20-ATTACHED-PHASE-01: NEW source-specific bridge for the target-clock proposals in this cohort, not a general companion turn: an owner-attached recipient uses the original owner regular attached-phase beginning/end only for the stated spell packet or ending save. A future phase excludes one already underway. If no such real phase exists, retain a six-second spell-only checkpoint and finite original endpoint. This checkpoint supplies only a due packet/save or expiry that the spell actually grants; it supplies no Action, movement, Bonus Action, Reaction refresh, recharge, or ordinary death save. Source-required real Action/command maintenance cannot execute at an administrative checkpoint. Root identity, prior spent exposures, endpoint and finite tick count survive controller or schedule changes.
completeSharedRules.P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01: NEW per-source anti-duplication applies only where the individual procedure names a family cap: record target identity, named spell family, explicit category and numbered round. Different owners/casts share that named ledger; distinct spell names and explicitly separate Wall of Fire categories do not merge. Outside initiative use the scene continuing six-second exposure cycle, fixed before the relevant exposure. Preserve its spent state through a transition to the current combat round until that mapped interval ends; never refresh just by changing timing mode. Immunity/save/prevention after actual admission still consumes the exposure; wholly suppressed or geometrically ineligible sources cannot claim it. Simultaneous eligible sources use established application order then stable identity. Immolation instead uses the already accepted ongoing-fire arbitration at each identical target marker.
completeSharedRules.P20-DAMAGE-FUNDING-01: Reuse actual typed defenses, temporary HP, HP floors, Wounds, concentration, death/Null life order and one original recipient event. No inferred damage amount from structural failure or overkill. ActualDamageDealt remains real tempHP absorption plus normal HP loss. Healing/funding is a separate consumer: first exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flag forbids derived healing or recovery, then apply the spell-specific donor predicate, sum eligible branches once and floor the half once. Never count a split parent again. Burden Shared and Life Linked restrictions remain operative; a numeric branch amount alone is not funding permission. Preserve the distinct pending Leeching Plague donor exclusions and Enervation wider proposal for explicit Director disposition.
completeSharedRules.P20-RNG-INFORMATION-01: Authored dice are engine RNG. Original component identity, draw method, save factor and cached ordinal value remain private engine state unless an actual separately accepted presentation policy grants the exact disclosure. This candidate grants no new public dice viewer, hidden-target list, successful-save feedback, enemy-identity scan or Fate eligibility. Shared damage dice do not merge recipient roots. The accepted exact DE4 five-entry presentation policy applies only where its actual source predicates pass; it does not automatically disclose any private periodic, delayed, penalty or random-selection operation in this cohort. An actual qualifying OVERT-ATTACK d20 can use that entry without exposing a hidden Synaptic Static d6, hidden modifier cause or later damage pool. No sixth presentation entry is proposed here. No RNG seed or future draw is exposed. If a source has no admitted recipient and no explicit source-authored event-generation rule, do not invent a damage event merely to publish a roll.
completeSharedRules.P20-ROOT-01: Every damage source uses its explicit pending per-source mapping in damageRootProposals. These are NEW decisions requiring concurrence; accepted Forbiddance/Chain Arc/Skybrand and lower nightmare rules do not silently generalize. Root creation alone spends no Action, deals no damage, triggers no Wound, generates no material, and grants no hidden information. Pure transfer retains flags; an attached component can retain an old flag while a genuinely new operated attack creates its own root. Physical fire and Sonic debris mappings are bounded to the exact finite proposed outputs.
completeSharedRules.P20-SUPPRESSION-01: Reuse the exact actual suppressor/removal source. Lesser Antimagic, rank limits and source versus expression tests keep their accepted scope. AC6 Globe is not general antimagic: its fixed boundary blocks only its actual incoming rank-0–5 source cases, does not ban all internal casting, and does not erase an already attached buff merely because a creature enters. A fixed external ongoing field and a target-attached rider have different origin facts. A spell object is not a creature; physical Inferno fuel/rubble after actual creation is not a sustained magical field. No suppression pauses a deadline or restores a destroyed body, cleared crystal patch, spent shot or old command.
